{{Top|leg}}
'''Heating suits''' were used by the [[Tarong]] when travelling in cold areas. A Tarong exposed to near-freezing temperatures would die within three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. The heating suits covered the entire Tarong apart from their beak. Their wings were contained within the suit, limiting their movement.
